Local processing · No account needed
THE QUICK HOW-TO

Small task. Sorted.

Select a JPEG, PNG or WebP image, then enter the desired pixel dimensions. Keep aspect ratio enabled to avoid stretching. Choose JPG, PNG or WebP output. JPEG uses a white background for transparency. PNG output is lossless for the resized pixels and may be larger than the original.

Try this example

A 1600 × 900 image resized to 800 pixels wide becomes 800 × 450 with aspect ratio locked.

Good to know

How large can my image be?

This tool limits uploads to 20 MB and decoded or output images to 25 million pixels to reduce browser memory use.

Do I need to create an account?

No. All Toolnest tools work without an account. There are no paid features in this version.
